record.t: Was re-elected Minnesota Secretary of State, defeating Tad Jude, Chip Tangen, Seth Kuhl-Stennes, and Anuh'et Aesh.
record.q: Incumbent Steve Simon (D) defeated Tad Jude (R), Chip Tangen (L), Seth Kuhl-Stennes (G), and Anuh'et Aesh (Unaffiliated) in the general election for Minnesota Secretary of State on November 3, 2026.

record.t: Has refused to comply with the U.S. Department of Justice's request for records on Minnesota's voter registration practices, according to a congressman's statement.
record.q: In January of 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) requested Minnesota hand over records related to the state’s voter registration practices, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1960. To date, even with a suit brought forth by the DOJ, Simon has refused to comply with the DOJ’s request.
